title: In silico studies on the phytochemical components of Lagenaria siceraria targeting aromatase receptors against breast cancer.
one_liner_zh: 该研究针对植物成分与芳香化酶受体（非DNA）的分子对接和动力学模拟，属于蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In India, breast cancer is the most common cause of mortality for women and has the potential to spread to other body organs. As a transcription factor, interactions with the estrogen receptor (ER) alpha are primarily responsible for the development of malignant tumors. Aromatase inhibitors are the most often used treatment for ER(+) breast cancer. Various synthetic compounds have been developed over the years to block the aromatase receptor, however, the majority of them are hazardous and cause multidrug resistance. So, combating these natural drugs can be prioritized. The current study was conducted to investigate the anticancer potential of Lagenaria siceraria phytoconstituents against breast cancer target protein (PDB ID: 3EQM) based on a literature review. In this study, 34 Lagenaria siceraria ligands were chosen, and the structure of the human aromatase receptor was acquired from the protein data bank. For those natural chemicals, molecular docking, drug-likeness, toxicity, and molecular dynamics were used to evaluate and analyse their anti-breast cancer activity. Five substances, 2,3-Diphenyl quinoxaline, 17-Acetoxy pregnolone, Benzyl-d-glucoside, Ergostenol acetate, and Stigmast-7-en-3-ol, shown higher binding affinity than Tamoxifen, signaling their potential use in breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 在印度，乳腺癌是女性死亡的最常见原因，并有可能扩散至其他身体器官。作为一种转录因子，与雌激素受体（ER）α的相互作用主要负责恶性肿瘤的发展。芳香化酶抑制剂是ER（+）乳腺癌最常用的治疗方法。多年来，已开发出多种合成化合物来阻断芳香化酶受体，但其中大多数具有毒性并导致多药耐药性。因此，优先考虑对抗这些天然药物是可行的。本研究基于文献综述，旨在调查葫芦（Lagenaria siceraria）植物成分对乳腺癌靶蛋白（PDB ID: 3EQM）的抗癌潜力。本研究选取了34种葫芦配体，并从蛋白质数据库获取了人芳香化酶受体的结构。对于这些天然化合物，采用分子对接、药物相似性、毒性和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 来评估和分析其抗乳腺癌活性。五种物质，2,3-二苯基喹喔啉、17-乙酰氧基孕烯醇酮、苄基-d-葡萄糖苷、麦角甾醇乙酸酯和豆甾-7-烯-3-醇，显示出比他莫昔芬更高的结合亲和力，表明它们在乳腺癌治疗中的潜在应用。
